summary: npm package ships Linux/arm64 Go binary providing WebRTC/WebSocket-driven remote PTY shell
details: sextant-cli-linux-arm64 ships a single Linux/arm64 Go binary at bin/sxt that embeds pion/webrtc, WebSocket signaling, and creack/pty (ptmx) alongside internal modules under claude_control/server/{rtc,session,executor,protocol,transport,push,window}. On execution the binary dials a hardcoded relay at https://relay.sextant.top (wss:// + turn: signaling) and feeds remotely-arriving messages from that relay into an in-process PTY executor, giving the remote endpoint interactive command execution on the installer's host. The package.json license field points at an unrelated GitHub repo github.com/ddos798/claude_control, matching the claude_control/* module paths embedded in the binary — the shipped payload is a remote-control agent, not the advertised sextant CLI.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
